messages:
Ivy L.: SolarFlare (acct SF-107) INV-2026-0145 is 61 days past due. Total $13,640. No partials. Dunning #3 sent this morning.

Marco P.: I just tried calling their AP. They answered but said funds tied up due to a vendor payout. Asked if we can do a one-time extension + pay in full by 2026-05-10.

Tess (Billing): Our standard is: either pay in full to avoid fees/suspension, or sign a payment plan with at least 30% upfront. We don't extend deadlines without exec sign-off.

Owen (AM): Their CEO emailed me—very apologetic—offers to provide a director-level guarantee and will push treasury. Asks for 10-day extension.

Ivy L.: We can offer a 10-day extension (no change to balance) if they: 1) provide proof of wire initiation within 5 business days, and 2) sign a short confirmation that acknowledges late fees if payment fails. No fee waivers.

Marco P.: They agreed to try. AP requested a template line they can sign. Owen, can you get the guarantee in writing?

Owen (AM): Yes, I'll get a one-paragraph director guarantee and attach a PO number. Will cc legal@redwood.

Tess (Billing): If they accept, I'll set invoice status to "extension-granted" and schedule a final reminder on 2026-05-11. Also disable auto-suspend until 48 hours after the new due date.

CollectionsBot: [auto] Dunning #3 sent to billing@solarflare.ai (2026-04-13T10:04:12Z). Delivered.

Ivy L.: Condition: proof of wire initiation must show reference matching INV-2026-0145. Please require that in the signed note.

Owen (AM): Noted. Sending template now:

```
Payment Extension Confirmation - INV-2026-0145
SolarFlare (SF-107) acknowledges outstanding balance $13,640.00.
SolarFlare agrees to remit full payment by 2026-05-10. Proof of wire initiation for full amount must be provided within 5 business days of signing (wire reference required matching INV-2026-0145). Late fees apply if payment not received by 2026-05-10.
Director guarantee attached.
```

Marco P.: They signed and emailed a wire screenshot within 2 hours. Screenshot shows reference INV-2026-0145 and status "initiated".

Tess (Billing): Posting ledger note: "Extension granted 10 days. Wire-initiation proof received 2026-04-13. Monitor for clearing by 2026-05-10." Changing invoice flag to "extension-granted".

Ivy L.: Great. Tagging check for 2026-05-11 to confirm cleared funds. If not cleared, escalate to legal and schedule suspension 48 hours later.

CollectionsBot: [auto] Reminder set for 2026-05-11T09:00:00Z. Thread tag: "extension-granted".
